The '''Far Indosa system''' was a part of the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Near Indosa system/Legends|Near Indosa system]] and contained two [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that had potential value for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="TEA" />

During the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the worlds of the Far Indosa [[Star system/Legends|system]] were opened for mining. Subsequently, the majority of the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] from the nearby world [[Near Indosa]], which had been mined for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] and had been nearly depleted of any valuable resources, relocated there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Far Indosa system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
